ARCHITECTURE_DESIGN.summary: Produced a design consistent with the existing layered architecture (controller/service/repository).

artifacts.designDoc:
Design for: Make analytics better
- API surface: extend existing url-shortener REST controllers (ShortenController/AnalyticsController) or add a new controller, following the existing Router/HttpCtx pattern.
- Data model: extend ShortUrl/ClickEvent records or add a new model class as needed.
- Persistence: extend the repository interface first, then the in-memory implementation, so a future durable-store implementation is a drop-in replacement.
- Rejected alternative: embedding this logic directly in the controller was rejected to keep business logic testable independent of HTTP.

TASK_DECOMPOSITION.summary: Decomposed the requirement into 8 sequenced engineering tasks.

artifacts.taskList:
1. Define/validate request & response schema for the change
2. Implement service-layer logic
3. Wire persistence/repository changes if data model is affected
4. Add/extend REST endpoint(s) and input validation
5. Add unit tests for service logic
6. Add integration tests exercising the HTTP API end-to-end
7. Update documentation (README/API docs)
8. Assess release readiness and rollback plan

artifacts.testPlan:

- Unit: happy path, invalid input, boundary values
- Unit: idempotency / repeated-call behavior where relevant
- Integration: full HTTP round-trip via the real router + in-memory repository
